{{Quote|Send three squads to help. Open the back door.|Hewex during the Battle of Endor|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
'''Hewex''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Major/Legends|Major]]. He was the leader of the Navy detachment assigned to guard the [[Endor shield generator bunker|deflector shield bunker]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a liaison between technicians and command staff. Initially, when the Rebels broke through the blast doors of the bunker, Hewex was captured and forced to move out of way at gunpoint. When the Rebels became overrun, Hewex stole [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] Bowcaster. Fooled by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] (posing as [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Marquand/Legends|Marquand]]), Hewex ordered three [[Squad/Legends|squads]] to help search for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. Solo and his team then infiltrated the bunker and destroyed it.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Alright! Up, you twits. Move! Move!|Han Solo to Hewex and the Imperials in the Endor shield generator bunker|<ref name="Episode 6" />}}
Before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] erupted in the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Hewex was stationed inside the [[Endor shield generator bunker|deflector shield bunker]] during the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Together with a fleet division, Hewex would guard the complex with the generator at all costs. In addition to this task, Hewex also served as a liaison officer between the bunker's command staff and the Imperial technicians.

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] learned of the plans of the Empire, a rebel strike team led by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] managed to land on Endor with the help of a hijacked Imperial Space Shuttle, the [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']]. The Alliance envisaged a ground force on Endor destroying the generator of the SLD-26 Shield to allow the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|rebel fleet]] in orbit to attack the the battle station. Together with the local [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], the rebels were able to invade the control bunker, destroy the generator, and subsequently destroy the Death Star.
